column_description: A SERIAL primary key uniquely identifying each engine/fluids record.
A VARCHAR(60) foreign key referencing Equipment(EquipmentCode), linking engine data to a specific equipment unit.
An INTEGER foreign key referencing PowerBattery(PowerBattRegistry), associating the engine with battery/power data if relevant.
An INT measuring engine speed in revolutions per minute (RPM).
A REAL value indicating the current engine load in percentage.
A DOUBLE PRECISION value measuring overall engine temperature in Celsius.
A DECIMAL(8,1) recording total operational hours on the engine.
An INTEGER optionally referencing an OperationMaintenance record if needed.

JSONB column. Groups fluid-related metrics for fuel, oil, coolant, and hydraulic systems, including levels, pressures, and temperatures.
